info.title: CamusDB.Dump
info.description: camus-dump performs logical backups, producing a set of SQL statements that can be executed to reproduce the original CamusDB database definitions and table data

options.name: --connection-source
options.description:
Full connection string. Individual options below
fill in any key it does not already set.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description:
Server endpoint, or a comma-separated pool
(default: http://localhost:5096, the gRPC port).

options.name: --database
options.description: Database to dump (default: test).

options.name: --all-databases
options.description:
Dump every database on the server instead of just
one.

options.name: --exclude-database
options.description:
With --all-databases, skip these databases
(comma-separated, or repeat the option).

options.name: --protocol
options.description:
Wire protocol: grpc (default) or rest. Each
addresses its own port on the server — pass an
endpoint that matches.

options.name: --user
options.description: User to authenticate as.

options.name: --password
options.description: That user's password. Prefer CAMUSDB_PASSWORD or

options.name: --ask-password
options.description: visible to other processes.

options.name: --access-token
options.description:
Bearer token obtained elsewhere, used instead of
logging in. Prefer CAMUSDB_ACCESS_TOKEN: a token on
the command line is visible to other processes.

options.name: --token-lifetime
options.description:
Seconds to reuse a minted token when the server
reports no expiry (default: 600).

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-statement timeout in seconds (default: 10).

options.name: --table
options.description:
Dump only these tables (comma-separated, or repeat
the option).

options.name: --exclude-table
options.description:
Skip these tables (comma-separated, or repeat the
option).

options.name: --where
options.description:
Dump only rows matching this WHERE condition. The
text is unparsed SQL and is spliced into the query
as given, so never build it from untrusted input.

options.name: --as-of
options.description:
Read every table as of this point in time: a
negative offset (-10s, -5m, -1h, -1d), an absolute
UTC timestamp ('2026-07-19 20:00:00+00:00'), or
Unix epoch milliseconds. Defaults to the instant
the dump starts.

options.name: --no-as-of
options.description:
Read the latest committed data instead of a fixed
point in time. Tables are then no longer read from
a common instant.

options.name: --batch
options.description: (Default: 1) Number of rows per INSERT statement.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Write the dump to this file instead of standard
output.

options.name: --output-directory
options.description:
Write one <database>.sql file per database into
this directory. The directory is created if
missing.

options.name: --no-create-table
options.description: Do not emit CREATE TABLE statements.

options.name: --no-data
options.description: Do not emit INSERT statements.

options.name: --no-indexes
options.description:
Do not emit the CREATE INDEX statements that follow
each table.

options.name: --defer-indexes
options.description:
Emit the CREATE INDEX statements after a table's
data rather than before it.

options.name: --add-drop-table
options.description: Emit DROP TABLE IF EXISTS before each CREATE TABLE.

options.name: --if-not-exists
options.description:
Emit CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS so the dump can be
replayed onto an existing schema.

options.name: --create-database
options.description:
Emit CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS for the dumped
database.

options.name: --single-transaction
options.description:
Dump every table from one lock-free serializable
snapshot, so the dump is consistent across tables.

options.name: --strict
options.description:
Fail instead of emitting NULL when a value has no
CamusDB SQL literal (ARRAY columns, strings holding
control characters).

options.name: --no-header
options.description: Omit the leading comment header.

options.name: --help
options.description: Display this help screen.

options.name: --version
options.description: Display version information.
